rationale: Third-party child injured due to hazardous condition of policyholder's premises (icy walkway); clear liability exposure.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child sustained a broken wrist after slipping on ice on policyholder's front walkway during an ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bills. Covered under homeowners liability with $500k limit and $1k deductible; high severity due to pediatric fracture injury.

case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway
